load_asset — DRIVE world op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.load_asset(name: 'str', dims=None, *, root=None, paint=None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import driveworld; driveworld.load_asset(name: 'str', dims=None, *, root=None, paint=None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("load_asset"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Loads a bundled asset as a mesh dict: {"V", "F", "color", "label", "name", "dims"}.

Converts to z-up, fits the box dimensions per axis to dims (default = the real dimensions in ASSETS), and places the origin at the centre of the box's bottom face. An unknown name or dimension ≤ 0 raises ValueError. The same name is read only once (cache).

paint: car body colour (a name from CAR_PAINTS or (r, g, b), None = original colour). Only the body faces are repainted; glass, tyres and lamps stay as they are, and the texture shading (brightness ratio) is preserved. Police cars and taxis (where the paint carries meaning) and non-cars raise ValueError.
